message.content:
Triage the new issue-tracker items below.

Summary: 3 new issues, 1 waiting reply

Details:
- #481 Date picker off by one day in negative UTC offsets
- #482 Typo in the setup instructions
- #483 Import fails on files over 50 MB
- #476 Reporter answered the follow-up question

For each item: reproduce it if that is quick, label it, answer the reporter, and fix anything that takes under ~20 lines. Commit fixes as you go and mention every issue number in your report.

Note: Also close issues that have been waiting on the reporter for more than 30 days.

content.thinking: Four items. #481 looks like a real bug, so reproduce it first; #482 is a quick docs fix; #483 needs a large file; #476 only needs a reply read.

content.text: I'll work through the four items one by one, starting with the urgent-looking crash.

input.description: Run the date picker tests in a negative UTC offset

content.content:
FAIL  src/date-picker.test.ts
  ✕ formats the selected day (12 ms)
  ✕ keeps the day across midnight (4 ms)

Tests: 2 failed, 14 passed

content.text: The root cause is in `shared/dates.ts`: `formatLocalDate()` formats in UTC. A proper fix touches every caller, so it is over the 20-line budget. I left a reproduction script on #481 instead.

content.content:
[main 3f8c21a] docs: fix setup typo (#482)
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

content.text: Tried importing a 200 MB fixture with no failure. I asked the reporter of #483 for the file header and the exact error, and labelled it `needs-info`.
#476: the reporter's answer confirms it duplicates the known crash, so I closed it with a link. Per the run note, I also closed #451, which has been waiting on its reporter since July.

input.command: looper-done success "Labelled 4 issues, fixed #482, closed 1 stale duplicate"

content.text:
## Triage report

- **#481**: reproduced, labelled `bug`, `timezone`; reproduction script left on the issue.
- **#482**: fixed and committed.
- **#483**: labelled `needs-info`, asked for the failing file.
- **#476**: closed as a duplicate.

Also closed #451 (waiting on its reporter since July).
